BiblicalUsage: The Nephushesim appear once, in Nehemiah's list of the families who came back from exile, counted among the temple servants. Their name sits among the other servant families, with no story attached — only the fact that they returned and their children were counted.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the honour here is simply being counted: no deed is recorded, only that they came home to serve God's house.
